what: Reproduction of the published pi0.5-LIBERO benchmark numbers with openpi's own unmodified eval loop (examples/libero/main.py), run before any number off the sketch-prompted validation scenes was believed. Section 3 of prompt_pi05_baseline.md.
render_backend: egl (RunPod pod has no X server; openpi's glx advice is inverted here)
docker_note: A RunPod GPU pod is itself a container; nested Docker is unsupported, so openpi's 'Without Docker' path was used.
verdict: Reproduces. Every suite lands within 2.4pp of its published figure (worst: libero_10, 90.0 vs 92.4) and the average is 96.0 vs 96.85, on 50 episodes per suite rather than 500. The observation pipeline and the reference preprocessing are therefore certified before section 6.
